About:

Meet Conan | Apply Here

Conan is 7 months old, 20lbs, and yes his ears are just like that. One ear chose to stand up while the other remained floppy; really the best of both worlds. Conan was rescued from a dog farm in Gyeonggi-do during our Operation 1M efforts alongside his siblings. Because of this, he mostly grew up in the loving care of our team in Korea at our Bundang center!

While he’s still trying to get his bearings in a big city, we can already tell with some encouragement Conan will run the streets. His curiosity keeps him learning and growing! Big trucks and sudden loud noises still make him jump a little, but with practice and more experience we know he’ll conquer his fears.

In his foster home he’s starting to get the hang of cozy places near his humans. He can be shy at first but if you give him a little space and a really comfy place to lounge, you’ll be best buds in no time. We truly cannot wait to see the goofy boy we knew Conan as at the center

You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.
